rubric.0: A current, evidenced failure or missing required control; status gap.
rubric.1: Intent/design is documented, implementation or execution is not established; status partial.
rubric.2: Control is implemented with limited/static evidence; required scenarios remain incomplete; status partial.
rubric.3: This checkpoint has substantial current evidence, but an applicable cross-check or scenario remains incomplete; status partial. Behavioral checkpoints require successful execution.
rubric.4: This checkpoint meets all its applicable acceptance conditions and cross-checks; status supported. Do not require sibling checkpoints to pass before scoring this one. Behavioral checkpoints require relevant successful execution.
rubric.unverified: No defensible current score. Excluded from observed score, included in coverage denominator.
rubric.not_applicable: Evidence-backed scope exclusion. Excluded from scoring denominators and counted separately.

scorecard.weight_policy: Fixed area budgets total 100. Criterion priority is distributed within its area; interface count cannot expand its area budget. Excluded or unrepresented areas are disclosed and remaining budgets are normalized. Policy priorities, not calibrated incident probabilities.
scorecard.interpretation: Documented score is the achievement lower bound over applicable scope; unknowns contribute no earned points but are not classified as defects. Observed score describes scored evidence only. Compare coverage, exclusions and area budgets. Scores do not certify safety or authorize release.

limitations: Evidence hashes verify artifact identity, not truth or adequacy. Supported means a named reviewer attested to evidence for this scope/revision. Graph freshness and runtime behavior are not established by a graph export. Scores describe reviewed evidence maturity, not safety certification.
